div.div: A Fix or Rethink verdict sends the team back to Creative Studio. Every workspace reads and writes the same evidence record, so the Proof Report can answer "why did we make this decision?" from stored data. Predicted vs Actual ranks Lab predictions and Launch scores against Live Pulse results.
